title: Rebuild truth without multiplying the incident
description: Choose an incident, historical source, write contract, and validation posture. The recovery model shows whether replay restores correctness or creates a second failure.

incidents.label: Bugged feature transform
incidents.detail: A code release computed the wrong currency normalization for 24 hourly partitions.

incidents.label: Source redelivery storm
incidents.detail: A reconnect replayed acknowledged events and duplicated stable event IDs.

incidents.label: Late mobile events
incidents.detail: Offline devices delivered valid events after six feature windows had closed.

sources.label: Current serving copy
sources.detail: Fast to access, but prior values and deleted records may no longer exist.

sources.label: Versioned raw snapshot
sources.detail: Preserves record identity, original event time, and the affected interval.

writes.label: Blind append
writes.detail: Adds replay output beside existing rows without reconciliation.

writes.label: Atomic partition replace
writes.detail: Builds each affected partition in shadow and swaps its manifest after validation.

writes.label: Merge by stable record key
writes.detail: Updates or inserts one logical record while retaining unaffected rows.
